method: Fresh isolated test package; legitimate touchscreen input; read-only JDWP raw fields with numeric wrapper hash checks; no JDWP method invocation/field writes, SQL updates, clear-data, uninstall or authentication fabrication.
passed: First install and actual farm entry without login or a server-connect confirmation while airplane mode is on and Wi-Fi/mobile data are off.
Installed APK has no INTERNET permission and its SHA-256 matches the delivered artifact.
HUD and read-only guarded-field checks confirm initial coins9,999,999, cash9,999,999 and level50; XP0 and tutorial1 are unchanged by the test grant.
Original tutorial harvesting empties the wheat plots, then legitimate wheat planting deducts10coins to9,999,989 and visibly creates a crop.
Two separate force-stop/cold launches after durable Home saves preserve coins9,999,989, cash9,999,999, level50, XP0, tutorial8 and the planted crop; no grant refill or tutorial reset.
Grant marker initially shares generation12 with the full farm snapshot; marker stays generation12 through final durable full snapshot83.
No FATAL EXCEPTION, fatal signal or test-app ANR in captured app logs; crash buffers are empty for all three process instances.
Original normal and legacy app packages were not installed, uninstalled, cleared or opened during this QA.
not_verified: Cash spending through UI was not exercised; the current early tutorial restricts reachable actions. Cash is verified unchanged at9,999,999 after both reopens.
Complete crop growth/reharvest cycle, all quests/items, high-level unlock behavior, sound and long-session gameplay are outside this short offline smoke test.
Physical devices and Android versions other than emulator API28 were not tested.
Real online login/backend success is intentionally disabled in this separate profile and was not tested.
observations: A dismissible original NEW advertising-information panel appears on first launch with the max-level profile; closing it reaches the original Welcome/farm tutorial.

Original wrapper SDK still attempts a startup background HTTP call and prints an IOException because cleartext HTTP is blocked. No request can reach a backend without INTERNET permission. This produced no fatal exception or login/server wait in this test.

Cold launch has a loading splash on this slow software emulator. Numeric reads before world load show original static defaults; only reads after world-ready farm state are used as persistence evidence.
final_device_state: Test game sent Home after durable save; original airplane/Wi-Fi/mobile-data settings restored (0/1/1).
